Responsive Edge Executor. Now armed with Native Offline J.A.R.V.I.S. Voice Engine (TTS) and Tap-to-Talk Speech Recognition (STT).

⚡ Download Phase 3 APK
Testing & Installation Instructions:
1. Tap Download Phase 3 APK → Open file → Tap Update / Install.
2. Grant Microphone permission when prompted.
3. Tap the glowing Mic button and say:
• "Storage status" or "Battery check"
• "Launch Camera" or "Open Calculator"
• "Clear cache" (Listen to spoken safety alert!)

New in Phase 3 Build:

  • 🎙️ Tap-to-Talk Voice Input: Android native SpeechRecognizer with mic animations.
  • 🔊 J.A.R.V.I.S. Audio Output: Crisp offline TTS feedback for telemetry & actions.
  • 🛡️ Spoken Security Prompts: Spoken warning when sensitive actions are triggered.
  • ⚡ Reactive Arc Reactor: Core pulses and reacts while speaking and listening.
